description: Local-first runtime security for AI coding agents (Windows Desktop MSI).
notes: HOL Guard Desktop is installed system-wide via MSI (requires admin).
Public installer URL redirects; hash verified for HOL-Guard-Desktop-3.0.75-x64.msi.
Maker/publisher: HOL. Core Guard Local is Apache-2.0.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (-not $success) { error "HOL Guard Desktop MSI installation failed"; break }

pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (-not $success) { error "HOL Guard Desktop MSI uninstall failed"; break }
